location_note: Western and southern walls of the Herodian Temple Mount (northern 'offset', Wilson's Arch, Robinson's Arch, south-western corner); no map reference. Placed by name (Jerusalem, Z4).
notes: Five horizontal gutter-like channels cut in the Herodian courses; described from earlier publications plus the authors' 'recent observation' of the plaster, so coded as inspected (choice C10). Dating is the authors' argument (Second Temple, probably before 70 CE) against earlier Byzantine-Early Islamic or later attributions. Parallels at other sites are cited; not coded.

features.subtype: five horizontal gutter-like channels hewn in the Herodian wall courses, some with plaster traces
features.period: Second Temple period, probably before 70 CE (authors' argument); cancelled by Early Islamic construction at one point
